s: Dine chatzitza utebila, ubo ch' seipim: kol dabar hachotzetz bitbilat kol haggup — chotzetz bintilat yadayim, shekkol mah shettiqqenu chakamim tiqqenu keen shel tora, ulepikak tzarik (letaher) [lizzaher] mikkol dabar shemmaqpidim alayv lahasiro lipamim. Kegon tzoa shettachat hatztzipporen shello keneged habbasar, dehaynu im hatztzipporen gadol veodep al besar haetzba veyesh sham tzoa tachat odep zeh — tzarik lahasirah qodem netila, lepi shedderek rob bene adam lehaqpid aleha mishshum mius, laken enah betela legabbe hayyad vechotzetzet ap lemi sheeno maqpid aleha. Ubatzeq shettachat hatztzipporen apillu keneged habbasar, derek rob bene adam lehaqpid alayv, vechotzetz lekol adam kesherochatzim yedehem:

Retiyya sheal besaro, im en sham makka ella michush beolma veyukal lahasirah matay sheyyirtzeh — tzarik lahasirah qodem netila. Abal im yesh sham makka — en tzarik littol kelal bimqom haretiyya, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"b:

Tit habborot vetit hayyotzerim shehem nidbaqim beyoter umoneim hammayim millabo tachtehem, veken shear kol hattit keshehu yabesh venidbaq babbasar — chotzetzin ben al gabbe hayyad ben tachat hatztzipporen, apillu keneged habbasar. Ella im ken hu dabar muat sheen derek bene adam lehaqpid alayv lahasiro (kesherochetz umenaqqeh yadayv) — en tzarik lahasiro gam ken lintilat yadayim lasseuda. Vehu haddin lebatzeq vetzoa, im hen meat kol kak sheen derek rob bene adam lehaqpid alayv — eno chotzetz, apillu hu shello keneged habbasar. Veim hu maqpid alayv — chotzetz, ap al pi sheen harob bene adam maqpidim alayv. Umah shello nahagu lenaqqer hattit shettachat hatztzippornayim qodem hannetila, hu mishshum sheen maqpidin lahasiro (bishat rechitzat veniqyon yadayim bimdinot ellu, laken eno chotzetz lintilat yadayim im hu keneged habbasar, apillu hu tit habborot vehayyotzerim. Abal im hu maqpid alayv — tzarik lahasiro. Veyesh omerim shekkol dabar sherob bene adam en maqpidin alayv ap al pi shehu maqpid — botla dato etzel kol adam. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bintilat yadayim sheiqqarah middibre soperim, abal lo bitbilat kol haggup, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman qtz"ch). Veim hatztzippornayim gedolim veodepim al habbasar — tzarik kol adam lenaqqer hattit vehatztzoa shettachtehem, ki rob bene adam maqpidim al mah shello keneged habbasar, vechotzetz ap lemi sheeno maqpid, ella im ken hu meat kol kak sheen derek lehaqpid alayv. (Ubeshabbat — docheq et habbasar shettachat hatztzipporen, kede shello yigror et hatztzipporen keshemmesir hattit):
Tzarik lizzaher betzipporen shepperesha miutah laqutz otah, shehi chotzetzet, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman qtz"ch:

Haddeyo vehatztzeba, lachim — enam chotzetzim, mippene shennimchim bammayim, yebeshim — chotzetzim. Vehu sheyyesh mammashut hatztzeba al yadayv, abal im en alehen ella marit hatztzeba — eno chotzetz. Umi shehu tzobea — en hatztzeba chotzetz al yadayv, ap al pi sheyyesh mammashut shel tzibonim al yadayv. Veken mi sheummanto lihyot shochet o qatztzab veyadayv meluklakot tamid bedam — eno chotzetz. Veken lemoker shumman. Veap al pi sherob bene adam maqpidim, kevan sherob bene ummaniyyot hallalu en maqpidin — en chotzetzin lahem. Abal leacher sheeno ragil bekak — chotzetzin, apillu eno maqpid. Vehannashim sheddarkan litzboa yedehem lenoy vekayyotze bazeh — en oto tzeba chotzetz. Vekol zeh bemiut hayyad, abal im rob hayyad mekusseh bedabar sheyyesh bo mammash — chotzetz apillu leotam sheen darkam lehaqpid:

Rir hayyotze min hammakka umityabbesh venaaseh gelid, im eno maqpid alayv lahasiro, o shemmitztaer lahasiro, shemmeatta en dato lahasirah kol zeman sheyyihyeh beinyan zeh — qaruy eno maqpid, veeno chotzetz lintila, ap al pi shellitbila machamirin:

Tabbaat, keshehi dechuqa baetzba — chotzetzet, urepuya — enah chotzetzet, ki hammayim baim benah laetzba. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla yesh lehasir hattabbaat qodem netila apillu repuya, ki en anu beqiim mahu [niqra] repuya veyabou lehaqel gam bidchuqa. Ubediabad — olta lo netila im hayeta repuya. Vehu sheshshapak aleha rebiit bebat achat, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"b. Abal im hayeta dechuqa — lo olta lo netila im lipamim maqpid aleha lahasirah, kegon sheyyesh bah eben toba shemmaqpid aleha lahasirah bishat netila shello titlaklek bammayim. Ubeishsha, apillu tabbaat sheen bah eben toba darkah lahasirah bishat lisha, laken chotzetzet leolam, ap al pi sheenah maqpedet lahasirah mishshum likluk hammayim. Abal haish sheen darko lalush — en tzarik lehasir hattabbaat sheen bah eben toba qodem netila apillu enah repuya, lepi sheeno maqpid aleha lahasirah leolam:

Shiur netilat yadayim, kol hayyad ad haqqaneh shel zeroa, keshiur qiddush yadayim shebbammiqdash. Veyesh omerim sheheqelu bintilat yadayim, velo hitzriku ella ad meqom chibbur haetzbaot lekap hayyad. Verauy linhog kassebara harishona, shekkevan shehu dabar sheen bo torach — lamma lo notzi napshenu mehammachaloqet? Venakon lehatnot velomar, sheeno meqabbel dabar zeh betorat choba ella betorat reshut, kede sheim ezeh paam lo yizdammenu lo mayim kol kak — lo yitztarek lehachamir keminhago. Veken rauy lehatnot bekol dabar sheadam rotzeh lehachamir al atzmo. Veim notel yadayv bipne rabbim bemaqom shennohagim littol ad meqom chibbur haetzbaot lebad — en lo lehachamir bipnehem, shello yehe nireh keb' torot chas veshalom beenehem. Veim hayu yadayv meluklakot — ledibre hakkol tzerikim netila ad hazzeroa:
